fb5b7d0c9e7d404e653b723c08858a5ef1766150.summary: AT&T Alien Labs analysed sample families of OS X malware from 2014 and 2015 in a sandbox: Flashback, KitM, LaoShu, Mask/Careto, CoinThief, WireLurker and OceanLotus. For each it records persistence mechanisms, C&C details and IDS detections. Most C&C servers were offline at publication. It also gives Open Threat Exchange statistics for the most-seen OS X threats.
